title: SignalGate Gate G5 Pre-Evaluation Protocol and Model Freeze Record
provenance_statement: Historical Gate G1 output already reported test-set baseline metrics in results/g1_baselines_report.json. That prior test-set look is explicitly documented and acknowledged. G5 is a frozen, controlled benchmark evaluation on immutable models and policies, NOT the first-ever test look and NOT a tuning exercise. No model, hyperparameter, threshold, or policy weight was tuned against test labels.

frozen_system.ensemble_architecture: EraBaggedHeterogeneousEnsemble (5 chronological era members: omitting era 0, 1, 2, 3, 4)
frozen_system.feature_preprocessing: FeaturePipeline (391 features: 377 numerical with median imputation, 14 ordinal categoricals; fitted strictly on train partition)
frozen_system.calibration_method: PlattCalibrator (sigmoid logistic regression fitted strictly on calibration partition, validation ECE = 0.0039)

workload_and_budget.deferred_treatment: HELD/DEFERRED reported separately; never counted as reviewed or silently treated as ROUTINE.

statistical_protocol.rule: Paired resamples matching identical records; significant if ci_lower > 0

acceptance_criteria_rules.AC1: At least +2.0 percentage points recall improvement over B2 at the primary workload (1.5x), with 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0.
acceptance_criteria_rules.AC2: Match B2 recall while touching at least 10% fewer transactions.
acceptance_criteria_rules.AC3: Shift-robustness comparison across S0, S1, S2, S3 against baseline B2.
acceptance_criteria_rules.AC4: At least 10% reduction in confident misses (fraudulent cases routed to ROUTINE).
acceptance_criteria_rules.AC5: Single-row p95 latency <= 50.0 ms under documented conditions.
